about: Every place the BepInEx plugin touches Paint the Town Red 1.3.4 (Unity 2020.3.39f1, IL2CPP). member is Class.Member as in Il2CppDumper's dump.cs; preflight checks each still exists there, so a PTR update that renames one shows up before a build.

rows.purpose: Pirate Cove by night is the same scene as by day: this flag gives it its own Minecraft world
The custom level being played (yours or the Workshop's): one Minecraft world per level file
Which arena challenge (1st to 5th) is being played: each has its own Minecraft world (Arena1..Arena5); checked every second, as the scene stays the same
The endless arena gets its own Minecraft world even if PTR plays it in the Arena scene
Which Beneath area (CAV, CRY, RUI, ISL, TRI, FIR): with the floor, picks the Minecraft world (Beneath-CAV-1, ...)
Which Beneath floor: each floor of each area has its own Minecraft world; checked every second
In the Trickster's area, which scenario room (Biker Bar, Disco, Prison, Pirate Cove): one world each
The area's name for the Minecraft world's title
Measuring colliders PTR can't hand out (unreadable meshes, terrain): rays at that collider alone, 25 cm apart, from all six sides
Character controllers are someone walking about: never level collision (only the type is used)
The trigger zones PTR's player's capsule is in, where Minecraft put it (its CharacterController is off while Minecraft plays)
OnTriggerEnter / Stay / Exit sent as Unity would: Beneath's hub elevator and exits, portals, boss and challenge rooms, shops, pickups
One of the trigger handlers that need the player (Beneath's exits); reached through SendMessage
Leaves out trigger zones PTR's people carry, walking up the parents (GetComponentInParent and Physics.GetIgnoreLayerCollision are stripped from PTR's build, so PTR's layer matrix can't be read)
Beneath is between floors (its elevator ride, a portal): Minecraft doesn't take over until it's done and PTR's player is at rest
Minecraft fire on a PTR person: PTR's own burning (flames, damage over time, panic), as the arena's fire does
Already burning: don't light again
Beneath's enemies get the Beneath knockback scale
A custom level is still being built: no collision build or takeover yet
A custom level has started: collision and takeover may go
Testing from the editor plays a shared temp file: the world is named after the level being edited
The name of the level being edited, for its Minecraft world
